body:
To filter the visible text, parse each markup string and search its plain value, for example `Text.from_markup(value).plain`; the [markup documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst) describes this conversion. For help adapting it to Beaupy menu items, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions); usage questions belong there.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
